references.usage: Industrial machinery mechanic occupation and reassembly context; no assets copied.
Occupation family and conveying-system maintenance/reassembly context; not an estimate of workers performing this exact assembly.
Industrial conveyor-chain dimensional families and connecting-link hardware; dimensional context, not a claim of an exact catalogue part. No assets copied.
Manufacturer connecting-link, cover and spring-clip/cotter assembly and groove engagement. No assets copied.
Native USD angular drive stiffness/damping units; spring coefficients converted from per-radian SI.

fidelity: Representative 100 mm conveyor joint: 12 mm pins, 12.2 mm bores, a closed cover and two passive spring clips in real grooves. End nests and five hold-downs fix the loop. A bench-mounted applicator moves on two passive prismatic guides representing linear bearings. All fitting uses native contact; constant angular springs approximate clip compliance. Fixture and spring parameters remain constant throughout each episode.
runtime_configuration: Standard PhysX actuator path, a permanently clamped zero-DOF loop, a fixed-base passive two-axis applicator guide, passive clip springs, and the standard fourteen robot controls. No runtime constraint or physics-property switching.
reference_controller: Nominal Cartesian fixture program converted to fourteen robot controls. Runtime input is elapsed time and ordinary measured robot joints only, with integral joint tracking and synchronization at declared precision poses; no task-body/contact/score feedback.
